chunks: Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Ali, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about the souls of the polytheists, so he said, '[They will be] in the Fire facing punishment and will say, "Our Lord, do not bring upon us the Hour [of Judgment], and do not fulfil for us what You promised us, and do not join the last of us with the first!"'
ai.seo_question: What do the souls of polytheists say in the Fire regarding the Hour of Judgment?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kitab al-Zuhd*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the souls of polytheists are actively punished in the grave, engaging in a desperate plea for the Day of Judgment to be delayed or for their end to be severed from their beginning. This highlights the Shia understanding of *Barzakh* not merely as a passive waiting period, but as a realm of active retribution where the disbelievers' regret manifests in their desire to escape the continuity of their torment.
